description: This file is a shell script for testing a Git 'proc-receive' hook. It defines functions to set up upstream and workbench repositories, executes test cases for 'local' and 'http' protocols, and includes setup and teardown steps for testing environments related to Git hooks. The script references external test libraries and functions, orchestrates a series of test scenarios, and manages repositories to validate hook behavior.

methods.name: setup_upstream_and_workbench
methods.description: Sets up upstream and workbench Git repositories with specific refs, tags, and hooks for testing.

methods.name: run_proc_receive_hook_test
methods.description: Executes test cases for the 'proc-receive' hook using either local or HTTP protocols.
